jobs.title: FP&A  Strategy Intern
jobs.description:
About the team

Corporate FP&A is SumUp's internal strategy and finance partner to business leaders— the team that turns data into the decisions that move the business. We build the forecasts, scenario models, and business cases behind capital allocation, reporting strategy, and investor relations. Think of us as an in-house consulting team with a finance lens. As our FP&A Strategy Intern, you'll own real analyses from day one and see your work shape decisions at the leadership level.

You can apply for this role if you are based in Santiago or São Paulo.

What you'll do

- Build and maintain financial and strategic models to evaluate capital allocation trade-offs, market-entry scenarios, and long-range business plans

- Conduct deep-dive analyses on internal data to surface risks, opportunities, and strategic insights that inform executive decision-making

- Drive cross-functional strategy projects — pricing optimisation, revenue growth levers, unit-economics improvement, or cost-efficiency initiatives — and present recommendations to senior leadership

- Develop investment cases and business cases for product launches, geographic expansion, and strategic initiatives, translating complex analysis into clear narratives for board-level reporting

- Design and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and performance frameworks , and contribute to the automation of analytical workflows using modern tools and scripting

You'll be a great fit if…

- You completed (or you're about to complete) a Master's degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a quantitative field from a top-tier university

- You think in a structured, hypothesis-driven way — you can take an ambiguous strategic question, break it into a clear issue tree, and drive to a data-backed recommendation

- You've had a first taste of high-impact problem-solving through internships in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, venture capital, growth-stage startups, or investment banking

- You're a strong analytical modeller — confident building scenario analyses and sensitivity models in Google Sheets or Excel, and you can (or want to learn to) automate workflows with Apps Script or Python

- You can tell a crisp, visual story in slides — distilling complex analysis into clear, executive-ready narratives in Google Slides or PowerPoint

- You have solid financial acumen — you understand P&L drivers, unit economics, and how business performance flows through the numbers

Why you should join SumUp

- Work on real strategic questions alongside SumUp's finance leadership — your analysis will feed decisions affecting 4 million+ merchants across 37 markets

- A steep learning curve with direct mentorship from senior FP&A managers who've come from consulting and banking backgrounds

- A role that blends strategy, finance, and data — the kind of experience that accelerates careers in corporate strategy, investing, or operating roles

- Extras like an Urban Sports Club subsidy and subsidised office lunches

- A truly global, multicultural team of 4,000+ SumUppers from 90+ nationalities

About SumUp

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe with simple, affordable tools that help them thrive. Over 4 million businesses across 37 markets rely on SumUp to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not make hiring decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion, ethnic or national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Fraud Prevention Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Fraud Prevention Manager

Fraud Prevention team

SumUp's Fraud Prevention team sits at the intersection of risk, data and global payments, moving fast to stay ahead of one of fintech's most dynamic challenges: stopping fraud at scale across multiple markets and products. As the team shifts from a market based to a global, product focused model, this role takes on ownership of the Acquiring domain worldwide, a rare chance to shape a global strategy at a pivotal moment rather than inherit a finished playbook. Reporting directly to the Head of Risk & Fraud Prevention and partnering with a second global fraud prevention manager focused on non acquiring fraud, this is an opportunity to influence how SumUp protects approval rates and merchant trust everywhere it operates.

What you'll do

- Lead a team of fraud specialists through clear goal setting, coaching and strong execution standards, while hiring for open roles and building a culture of ownership.

- Own the global Acquiring fraud strategy roadmap, translating fraud trends, performance data and market needs into rule optimisation, threshold management and authentication strategies.

- Drive the review and testing of Acquiring rules to keep controls effective as fraud patterns evolve.

- Partner with Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Product and regional leaders to prioritise model development and improve fraud tooling.

- Monitor fraud and chargeback performance through KPIs and data analysis, diagnosing root causes and protecting approval rates across all markets.

You'll be great for this role if…

- Proven experience in fraud prevention, fraud strategy or risk management within payments or fintech, including hands on work with rules engines, decision systems or authentication strategies.

- Track record of hiring, coaching and managing performance as an experienced people leader.

- Strong knowledge of working with databases and building KPIs to measure the impact of strategy changes, with SQL or coding skills as a plus.

- Ability to influence and align cross functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Product and senior stakeholders, communicating fluently in English.

- A quantitative degree (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or a related field), paired with a growth mindset, quick adaptability and strong prioritisation under pressure.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our dynamic São Paulo hub in the heart of the city. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of R$ 10,000 for education, certifications, and conferences
🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 22 working days of paid leave, plus public holidays and special leave days
💪 Stay fit: Wellhub membership included and gym at the office
💼 Financial wellness: SumUp contributes to your private retirement plan with Santander
🧠 Mental well-being: access to Zenklub for therapy, coaching, and emotional wellness resources

jobs.title: Group Financial Controller – Legal Entities & Statutory Reporting
jobs.description:
Group Financial Controller

Team: Finance, Reporting & Controlling | Location: Sofia, Bulgaria (office first)

Team description

The Group Reporting and Controlling team is the backbone of SumUp's financial integrity, and as the business scales, its role in strengthening governance and reporting standards is becoming more critical than ever. This position gives an experienced controller real ownership over a portfolio of legal entities, direct influence on how SumUp standardises controls and reporting across regions, and a front row seat to the audit and governance work that comes with holding ourselves to the highest financial standards. It's a chance to shape how a fast growing fintech gets its financial house in order, working closely with the Head of Controlling and coordinating directly with external auditors at PwC.

Take a look inside our Sofia office .

What you'll do

- Own statutory audits and reporting compliance for a set of legal entities, including regular financial and balance sheet health checks

- Review accounting entries and reconciliations critically, with a focus on accuracy in high impact areas

- Lead month end closing activities in complex, high judgement areas such as transfer pricing and chargebacks

- Manage the annual closing process for designated entities and financial areas

- Coordinate directly with our external auditors and other stakeholders on audit and technical matters

- Prepare ad hoc reports on legal entity performance and jurisdictional requirements

You'll be great for this role if

- Strong knowledge of financial reporting principles under IFRS and GAAP underpins the way you approach controlling work.

- Experience owning a legal entity end to end, from balance sheet reviews to statutory compliance, comes naturally.

- Comfort working with stakeholders across tax, accounting, FP&A, and audit teams to resolve complex issues.

- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, spot the real blockers, and drive them to resolution.

- A qualified accounting background (ACCA or CIMA are a big plus).

Why you should join SumUp

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

jobs.title: Regional Finance Director
jobs.description:
Team description

You'll join SumUp's Finance Leadership Team at an important moment for our business across Brazil, Latin America and the wider Americas region. This role combines hands-on leadership of core finance activities with governance and oversight of credit, receivables and merchant liquidity management. Reporting to the VP Finance Operations, you'll work closely with FP&A, Treasury, Global Tax and local finance leaders to strengthen reporting, controls, statutory compliance and financial operations across the Americas and multiple expansion markets.

What you'll do

- Lead day-to-day finance activities across Brazil, Latin America and the USA, ensuring accurate reporting and clear insight for business decisions

- Partner with FP&A, Treasury and Global Tax on forecasting, performance analysis, tax execution, cash flow and other core finance activities

- Provide governance and oversight for credit, receivables and merchant liquidity management, working with relevant teams to identify risks and strengthen controls

- Lead financial governance and compliance, including audits, financial statement integrity, statutory requirements and regulatory obligations

- Take on formal statutory responsibilities within the first 6 to 12 months in the role

- Build and develop a high-performing finance organisation across the Americas, while supporting finance operations in multiple expansion markets as the business grows

You’ll be great for this role if

- Proven experience in Financial Services, Payments, FinTech or Banking, with strong finance leadership experience across Brazil and/or Latin America

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian statutory, tax and regulatory requirements, including experience with audits, filings, tax risk and financial services operations

- Strong understanding of credit, receivables and merchant liquidity management, with the ability to provide effective governance and oversight in these areas

- Experience leading operational finance activities across multiple markets, including reporting, tax, audit, statutory compliance and financial controls

- Track record of leading cross functional finance teams in complex, multi market environments, with strong executive stakeholder management

Why you should join SumUp
